name: Lamp
desc: A Simple device, designed to emit visible light. Sometimes affixed to helmets or even Weapons.

stat.effects: Each Activation causes the Lamp to emit white light within 10T Meters for 1 Minute.

name: Jumpers
desc: These boots allow their wearer to jump incredible heights, trailing thin whisps of glowing vapor.

stat.effects: You can Activate Jumpers whenever you Leap, increasing the Distance by 10T.

name: Anchor
desc: Under the clawed fingers of this gauntlet, friction is amplified 10-fold.

stat.effects: You can Activate an Anchor to hang from surface for T Minutes. This can support a nearly arbitrary amount of weight.

name: Skates
desc: Thin rails on the bottom of the sole which insulate the user from friction, increasing their speed.

stat.effects: Activated as a part of a Movement Action using your Running Speed, Skates increase your Movement by 10T, but you cannot stop unless you catch yourself on an Object or Engage a Creature.

name: Imaginary Pocket
desc: Despite the appearance of a loop of steel, an Imaginary Pocket contains a non-local space of arbitrary size, perfect for storing impossible mass.

stat.effects: The loop must be laid on a flat surface to be Activated. Each Activation opens a black opening into the depth of the Imaginary Pocket. This is a sphere of featurless black space, able to hold up to 50T Bulk of material. The Pocket remains open for 1 Minute or until closed. The interior pauses in time until it is re-opened.

name: Flicker Tag
desc: Paired cuffs and a storage device, a Flicker tag enables easy disposal and access to a select Item.

stat.effects: You can Activate the Tag to Banish or Summon an Item with a Tag, provided you wear the corresponding cuff. The Storage can hold up to 2T Bulk.

name: Shimmerweave
desc: Residue woven in moving patterns that flow through cloth, Shimmerweave sign of extreme prestige in Verdun high society.

stat.effects: Each Activation causes the Shimmerweave to glow for 24 Hours.

name: Scopes
desc: Lenses given the ability to focus light by Artifice. These allow the wearer to see impossibly far distances.

stat.effects: After each Activation, you can extend your Vision, up to 500T Meters away. This lasts for 1 Minute.

name: Orrery
desc: A model of Gaia and the Sun at a cartoonish scale, woven from light projected by a small orb.

stat.effects: After each Activation, the Orrery displays with a soft glow for 24 Hours.

name: Recorder
desc: Delicate bronze tubes bound to a sensitive, Residue hardened needle. A Recorder encodes sounds onto these tubes, called Scrolls, as tiny gyrating scratches.

stat.effects: After each Activation, you can Record anything audible around you until the Scroll is full or you stop the device. Each Scroll can contain up to 10T Minutes of audio.

name: Player
desc: The inverse of a Recorder, a dull needle designed to convey vibration to a curved metal amplifier.

stat.effects: After each Activation, the Player can replay T Minutes of audio from a Scroll.

name: Sigil Rune
desc: Carefully designed to appear like a normal Verdun Crown Post (the object to which a formal top-knot is tied) but able to emit a ghostly semblance of a Rune or Seal.

stat.effects: After an Activation, the Sigil Rune either receives a Rune or Seal to display (it must be held in contact with it) or displays such above it.

name: Burner
desc: Concentric rings of metal capable of emitting flames and ambient heat. Typically used for cooking or to warm an area.

stat.effects: When Activated, a the Burner generates a Radius T zone of Tier 2T Heat for the purposes of counter-acting Cold. Touching the Burner inflicts Incendiary Damage.

name: Conduit
desc: Capable of creating a vacuum, Conduits are used to transport liquids within Arks, but can also be used to collect or dispense anything fit for a pipe.

stat.effects: When Activated, the Conduit pulls T Bulk of a given liquid in a single direction along a connected enclosed pipe or hose. This direction can be reversed with another Activation and lasts for 1 Hour continuously.

name: Preserver
desc: Enclosed within such a device, decay and, consequently, time itself is arrested for a while. This is employed both in the maintenance of perishable goods as well as some kinds of imprisonment.

stat.effects: Each Activation Halts the contents, no more than 10T Bulk, for 24 Hours. Halting prevents the progression of time for anything within.

name: Link
desc: Links transmit small movements and impulses across surprisingly far distances.

stat.effects: When two Links are connected (requiring Touch) Activating one can trigger something properly connected with the other. For example, a pulled cord transmits the Activation to another Link, which Activates a connected Lamp. You can connect as many Links as you wish, but their transmission range is limited to T Kilometers. Activation, not receiving an Activation, is what triggers the Plug consumption.

name: Piston
desc: Drive in a box, capable of providing steady pushing force over longer periods of time.

stat.effects: After each Activation, the Piston can either push or pull for the next Hour (according to some sequence or steadily) as if it were a Creature with 10+5T Body.

name: Relay
desc: An advanced component of larger structures of Artifice or devices of convenience, Relays serve an extremely wide range of uses.

stat.effects: A Relay is connected to a supply of Residue via its passive element (not physically connected to the device itself) and Activates whenever something connected with its active element (the main device) would consume Residue. The Relay conveys the needed amount from the source to the distination as if the two were Engaged. The active element of a Relay can provide this for Items within T Meters, but no more than 2T Residue per Round.

name: Safety Net
desc: Deceptively decorative, this mesh of Residue-laden thread is typically worn the waist with one's belt sash.

stat.effects: When a single instance of Damage would kill you, the Safety Net instantly skips your body forward in time by 6T Seconds. This interrupts the Damage before it happens, and returns you to the same Space after the Duration.

name: Life Mask
desc: The crowning achievement of Artifice, consolidated into an otherwise normal Breathing Apparatus.

stat.pattern: Substance, Regeneration, Control, Manifestation, Possibility, Sun
stat.effects: Each Activation of a Life Mask produces a Minute's worth of sufficient breathable air for a single person from nothing at all.

name: Personal Ward
desc: Inlay set into the surface of one's Armor, able to project a Ward nearly as durable as a Mage's own.

stat.effects:
Each Activation produces a Magical Ward for the wearer. Each time you are Attacked, this makes it less Vicious by 2T and suffers one Notch. Blunted Damage is totally negated before resolving against your Armor.
2T. The Ward is dispelled when Broken and the Item is deactivated.
Activating the Ward again removes one Notch.

name: Rime-Bane / Dragon Ward
desc: Inner lining of one's Armor, designed either to expel or generate Heat to resist environmental hazards.

stat.effects: When Activated, Worn Rime-Bane or Dragon Ward reduces the effects of Extreme Heat or Cold, depending on its initial construction design. It reduces these effects by 3T for up to 1 Hour.

name: Vanishing Bangle
desc: Capable of somehow displacing the light that would touch the wearer, these Items carry an ill repute as assassin's gear.

stat.effects: When Activated, the wearer cannot be seen at all for the next T Rounds. You can choose to let this run, consuming Residue each Full-Turn, or end the effect at the conclusion of the Duration.

name: Stasis
desc: Full restraints, tailored for variety. A Stasis locks its wearer in time, like a Preserver, but with more flexible means. This is the common tool for arrest and capture, especially of dangerous subje…

stat.effects: When Activated, the Creature wearing the Stasis is frozen in time for T Hours. While frozen in this way, they are Helpless.

name: Amplification Bands
desc: Usually worn on the arms, Amplification Bands can negate a certain amount of fatigue for their wearer, but prolonged use tends to be very dangerous.

stat.effects: When Activated, the wearer's Reserve is increased, up to 2 T, for 1 Minute. At the end of that Duration, they suffer T Persistant Strain.

name: Greenlights
desc: Worn over the eyes, Greenlights are a popular inclusion into Expeditioners' Breathing Gear, as the luxury of ample light is not always present in the Shard Sea.

stat.effects: When Activated, the wearer is able to see in complete darkness as if it were day for T Minutes. Though, this vision lacks color and is cast in a titular viridian hue. Exposure to bright (as daylight) light while your Greenlights are active makes you Blind until it is removed or the lightsource is.

name: Grinder
desc: Voltaic destruction channeled into the tip of a spinning wheel, held in a crude steel harness. More tool than Weapon, Grinders are able to function in either capacity with cruel effect.

stat.effects: A grinder is a Melee Weapon which counts as an Bludgeon, inflicting Crushing Damage. When Activated it becomes an Axe and deals Chaos, Cutting, and Incendiary Damage.

name: Booster
desc: While not literally an amplifier of speed or time, a Booster is able to warp its wearer's interaction with cause and effect, shifting their Actions in terms of priority.

stat.effects: You can Activate a Booster each time you roll Initiative, increasing your effective Reflex by 2T. For that Round, your Movement is increased by T, and you have 1 extra AP. If that extra AP is spent on another Primary Action, you suffer 1 Persistant Strain.

name: Cushion
desc: Braces to the legs, a Cushion both insulates their wearer from shock and allows them to lighten their burdons. Very popular for longer Expeditions.

stat.effects: You can Activate a Cushion whenever you Roll to negate the Damage from Falling completely. Likewise, you can Activate it to reduce your current overall Weight by 10T for 1 Hour.

name: Gauntlets of Power
desc: Shrouding the arms in black iron, coursing with veins of glowing blue Residue, these Gauntlets grant the fists supernatural impact.

stat.effects: The wearer can Activate their Gauntlets whenever they make an Unarmed Attack to remove the Blunt Trait and make it Powerful, up 2T, or when Shoving to add as many Meters to the displacement. Further, as a part of the Action when lifting, dragging, pushing or pulling, the wearer can Activate the Gauntlets to double their effective Body for that purpose for 1 Minute.

name: Candle Burst
desc: Light packed into a metal cannister, ready to explode.

stat.effects: This is a Light Bomb that is Activated as a part of being Thrown. It deals no Damage, instead, everything in a Burst equal to T Meters from where it lands suffers Minor Panic Risk and is Blind for T Rounds.

name: Helljar
desc: Tightly coiled copper rings binding an unstable Residual core.

stat.effects: This is a Light Bomb that Activates when Thrown and ignites Spaces in a Burst instead of dealing Damage directly. This Burst is equal to T Meters and ignited Spaces are Burning for T Minutes. A Creature struck by a Helljar suffers Fire Damage as if starting their Turn in one of the Spaces instantly.

name: Breath of Ventus
desc: An extremely lethal explosive, combining some of the most dangerous techniques of Artifice into a small, deceptively innocent package. The titular associating with the rogue god of cyclones and mayhe…

stat.effects:
This is a Light, Tier_T Bomb that Activates when Thrown. In addition to the Incendiary Damage from the Explosion everything with the Explosion is repelled from its center to its edge. If they collide with something on the way, they suffer additional Crushing Damage as if Falling T Meters. (This Damage is added to the Fire Damage, combined for passing DT.)
At the end of the Round following the Explosion, everything with twice the Radius is struck by a pulse of voltaic energy, suffering Chaos Damage.

name: Monodron
desc: A spheroid with minimal senses and capacities. Monodrons perform little more than manual functions, but are often useful for automating incredibly simple tasks.

stat.effects:
A Monodron can be given a sequence of Commands, no longer than T+1. This is given a name and, when the name is given as a Command, the Monodron will perform the sequence. The contents of the Commands can be indexical, for example, "Move in front of me" "Pick up that(pointed at object)" "Follow me".
Melee, Crushing, -2_Accuracy
Rating_Physical, Resistence-1_All.
If Small, it gains a Flying Speed equal to its Walking Speed.

name: Duodron
desc: Loosely patterned after a Verdun, Duodron Automata are useful for moving larger loads from place to place, or crushing stationary Targets.

stat.effects:
Duodrons have twice the normal maximum Encumberance for their Body, and can lift, drag, and bpush twice as much. When a Duodron Grapples something, escape is also twice as hard.
Melee, Crushing, -3 Accuracy, Vicious
Rating_Physical, Resistence-3_All.
Duodrons are always Large.

name: Trion
desc: Little more than an Arquebus with legs, Trions can be tasked to man and reactively shoot to defend positions or, in the hands of more skilled Artificers, even accompany as mobile offense.

stat.effects:
Trions have a generic Object permenance and conditionality, allowing the employ of extremely limited if-conditional or Target-conditional single Commands. For example "Shoot that(points to a Target)" will cause the Trion to Shoot at the pointed-at Target whenever possible, for as long as the Command remains in effect. Another example "Shoot anything that goes there (points to a door or other Space)" or (Shoot anything that does that(names an Action)".
Ranged_20T, Reload_3, Piercing, +1_Accuracy
Trions can Reload independantly of Commands after Shooting.
When a Trion would be Broken, roll a Chaos Die. On 1-3, the Trion self-deactivates instead, but is not Broken.
The Trion's Sharp has a reserve of 10 Bolts and Plugs, which are expended with each Shot.

name: Flametongue
desc: A powerful combination of Runes that allows the Weapon to be wreathed in deadly flames.

stat.effects:
When Activated, the Weapon deals Incendiary Damage for the next T Minutes. Likewise, the weapon counteracts up to Tier T Extreme Cold for the wielder, and can light things On Fire as a normal flame.
Flametongues are combined with otheriwse conventional Weapons, just like a Ghost Blade. However, the Flametongue can apply to any Melee Weapon regardless of the Damage Type.

name: Ghost Blade
desc: Pale light which drips from an edge, tracing cuts into swaths of deadly force.

stat.effects: When Activated, this extends the Weapon's Reach by T for 1 Minute. A Ghost Blade can only extend Cutting or Rending Damage (even if the Weapon dealt more).

name: Recall
desc: These blades seem to flicker, ever so slightly, instantly returning to the hand when thrown or dropped.

stat.effects: When Activated, as a 0 AP Reaction, the Weapon instantly flies back to your hand, so long as it less than 5T Meters from you.

name: Regenerating
desc: One of the most popular for its sheer usefulness.

stat.effects: Equipment bearing this Augmentation Activates automatically every 24 Hours, regaining 5T Durability.

name: Enhancement
desc: Magically augmented physical connections within the Armor.

stat.effects: This grants a Buff to the Durability of the affixed Armor by T for one Hour.

name: Abjurance
desc: One of the most desired of all Augmentation Runes, Abjurance can ablate threats and even harmful forces before the wearer is even touched.

stat.cost: 1,000×T×(The Base of the chosen Damage Type)
stat.effects:
For the next Minute after Activation, you gain Resistance to one Type of Damage, up to T. Damage Blunted by this is negated.
Multiple Runes of Abjurance may be affixed to the same Armor, but you must pay the Cost each time.
Loading the Residue needed is laborious, and requires at least 10 Minutes. The peripheral Fuel array of an Abjurance Rune can store up to T Activations worth of Residue.

name: Flicker Shield
desc: A prototype ward that stutters a moment out of sync, catching a blow before it has fully landed.

stat.effects: When Activated as a !0 AP Reaction to being Attacked, the triggering instance of Damage is skipped forward T Seconds and resolves at the start of your next Turn — you may Move before it lands. Each use Notches the Shield once.

name: Auld Lantern
desc: An older design kept for sentiment — its light lingers where you have already been.

stat.effects: Each Activation emits white light within 10T Meters for 1 Minute, and leaves a faint after-image of that light in each Space you left during the Duration for one further Round.
